summary: Full backend + frontend coverage of the new Drama Shorts vertical + VIP tier filter. Backend: 12/12 pytest tests pass (ShortsSeries CRUD with category, legacy backward-compat for xxx, video filtering by shorts_category, auto-exclusion of drama from latest/popular/random, PATCH validation, chunked-upload finish accepts shorts_category [skipped end-to-end persistence in this env due to synthetic media]). Frontend: LeftSidebar shows 'XXX Shorts' + 'Drama Shorts' with correct hrefs; /drama-shorts renders the heading + Romanian empty-state; Admin Panel exposes tab-drama-shorts-series; Upload page reveals upload-shorts-category-block when is_short is toggled; /popular, /discover, /all-episodes now render the search+filters panel; VIP tier chip is present and clicking it fires GET /api/videos?access_tier=vip. Home sections render in the correct relative order (drama sections not visible because backend has no drama shorts yet — expected).

ui_bugs.issue: Spec required data-testid='tier-vip' (and tier-free/tier-pro/tier-all) but FilterPill emits 'discover-pill-tier-vip' (prefixed). The chip works and correctly sends access_tier=vip — this is a testid naming mismatch only. Same issue affects tier-free, tier-pro, tier-all, and every 'cat-*' category pill (they become 'discover-pill-cat-*').

action_items: OPTIONAL (spec-conformance): rename the data-testid emitted by FilterPill in /app/frontend/src/pages/VideoList.jsx from `discover-pill-${testId}` to just `${testId}` so external playwright specs written against 'tier-vip'/'tier-pro'/'tier-free'/'tier-all'/'cat-<slug>' work as documented. Everything is functionally correct — this is a naming-only fix.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend query building in list_videos/count_videos combines a top-level `$or` (for `q` search) with another `$or` inside a `$and` (for shorts_category=xxx). This currently works because the xxx branch uses `$and` wrapping, but be careful: if any future code adds another top-level `$or` without wrapping in `$and`, Mongo will silently overwrite the first. Consider always building `$and: [...]` for combined disjunctions.
list_shorts_series & list_all_shorts_series duplicate the same category-filter logic; DRY into a helper.

success_rate.backend: 100% (12/12 tests pass, 1 skipped: chunked-upload finish e2e persistence not exercised due to fake media; PATCH validation confirms the schema accepts shorts_category)
success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all specified flows work; only the tier-* data-testid naming diverges from spec)

seed_data_creation: Backend pytest seeded and cleaned up: 2 ShortsSeries via API (TEST_dramafeat_* xxx + drama), 1 legacy series inserted directly in Mongo (no category field), 4 videos (xxx short, drama short, legacy short, long-form). All cleaned up via module-scoped fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is solid. If the tier-testid rename is applied in FilterPill, re-run playwright with [data-testid='tier-vip'] selectors (currently they must be 'discover-pill-tier-vip'). Home page drama sections only render when non-empty, so seed at least one drama short via admin upload before visually verifying section-drama-shorts / section-drama-shorts-series.
